name: ChatInbox
title: chatinbox.app
shortDescription: ChatInbox is a revolutionary email management app designed to streamline your email interactions. It structures your inbox by linking messages with their senders and recipients, allowing for a chat-style interface. Users can tag emails, visualize them on a Kanban board, and convert them into tasks within a planner view. Ideal for professionals looking to enhance productivity and maintain privacy, as the app ensures data never leaves your device.
cons: Dependent on user's email management habits
